notes.title: Demo 0.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
New Tutorial Update!

When our demo first launched, many players complained about the lack of guidance, as some game mechanics had a steep learning curve. Better late than never—the all-new tutorial is finally here!

Our rookie guide Eddie Bear has done an outstanding job walking players through the basics. Stay tuned—we'll meet this fluffy instructor again soon in future updates!

notes.title: Demo 0.4.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Major Updates:
1. Game Balance Adjustments
    ◦ Reworked numerical values to make early game more forgiving
    ◦ Special thanks to player [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198213486321/]Aquatia[/url] for this suggestion!
    ◦ ⚠️ If you encounter issues with old save files, please report them to us
2. UI Improvements
    ◦ Updated interface styling and visual elements
3. New Functional Furniture
    ◦ Added a dedicated watering can shelf next to workbenches
    ◦ Introduced a brand new furnishing item: Garden Bench

notes.title: Demo 0.3.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Key Updates:

1. Completely redesigned UI interface with new dynamic visual effects
2. Optimized order dispatch logic - order refresh now occurs at daily reset
3. Added additional UI tooltips and notifications

notes.title: Demo 0.2.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hotfix: Fixed a bug introduced in version 0.1.26 where transplanted plants from cultivation pots would not drop seeds.

[b]Special thanks to players [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198341953068][u]derrsteppenwolf[/u][/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198956473964/][u]Kira Mumpitz[/u][/url] for their feedback![/b]

notes.title: Demo 0.2.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
• Fixed some display errors related to image loading.

Optimizations:
1. Added game progress save functionality.
2. Improved action prompts before leaving the plantation.
3. Added reminders for when game progress is saved.
4. Added notifications for low stamina.

notes.title: Demo 0.1.26 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We would like to extend our gratitude to everyone who has provided feedback on bugs and offered suggestions and opinions via email, game reviews, the Steam community, and Bilibili comments. We are committed to enriching the game content and making it more enjoyable.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3530010][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503648/ed7bebb8f775bf22c3371332dfadbdeaca578aa5.png[/img] [/url]  [url=https://pd.qq.com/g/pd88289518][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503648/4e0ac1d19734f1dca4fbc3ebd02254ac25ec1e89.png[/img] [/url]
-----------------------------------------------

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
1. Resolved an issue where items held by characters occasionally would not display in one direction.
2. Fixed a problem where the footstep sound effects were not being controlled by the sound effect volume adjustments.

[b]Optimizations[/b]
1. Seeds dropped on the field no longer interfere with subsequent actions such as tilling.
2. Added a prompt to collect seeds from the field before leaving the plantation.
